description:
Submit a job to redact issue field data. This will trigger the redaction of the data in the specified fields asynchronously.

The redaction status can be polled using the job id.

202.description: Returned if the job submission is successful. The response contains the job id.

400.description: Returned if the redaction request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the user / app is not authorised to redact data

403.description: Returned if the AGP subscription is not present.
